Dogs up to 25 lbs only; larger dogs considered with owner approval and an additional $500 deposit. Pet rent $25 per pet, max 2 pets, $300 deposit per pet. Heat is gas. Tenant pays gas, electric. Water/sewer/trash paid by owner. Sec dep $2,275. $50 application fee per adult (nonrefundable). Move-in costs: first month + deposit. Walk to Fox Elementary (0.3 mi). Tours Tues and Thurs after 4pm, call to schedule.
